name: Bolt
summary: Prompt-to-app builder that scaffolds a real frontend project in the browser and lets you keep editing it.
description:
Bolt generates an actual codebase you can export rather than a locked canvas, which is the reason it gets used for more than screenshots: describe an app, get a working scaffold with dependencies installed and a preview running, then keep talking to it or drop into the files. For validating a product idea in an afternoon it is hard to beat.

What you should expect is a prototype-shaped result. Complexity grows faster than the generated code can absorb — auth, payments and anything with real data modelling tends to reach a point where a developer takes the repo and rebuilds parts of it. Token metering makes long iterative sessions expensive in a way that is easy to underestimate.
